src/intent-uri.ts.name: Intent link reader
src/intent-uri.ts.description: Turns a napplet intent link into a clean request of role, action, payload and handler hints; also runs inside napplets.

src/napplet-experimental.ts.name: Experimental switches
src/napplet-experimental.ts.description: Lists opt-in, off-by-default host hardening switches, such as locking nested frames, that may change without notice.

src/napplet-namespace.ts.name: window.napplet script
src/napplet-namespace.ts.description: Generates the one self-contained script placed before a napplet's code that gives it window.napplet for each offered domain.
